reviews_h2: What people say after we are done

reviews.author: Hannah H
reviews.text: These guys do it right… very trustworthy! Love shopping local with a multi-generation family business

reviews.author: Kevin Page
reviews.text: Barnes Collision Repair Center took in my 2021 Ram 1500 after I hit a deer. The damage was unbelievable as the deer was relatively small. Barnes Collision gave the truck back to me after 7 weeks, and it looked like a brand new truck. The body shop is amazing, and I was treated like family. I highly recommend Barnes Collision Repair Center for vehicle body damage, paint, or dent removal. Great job!

reviews.author: Miranda Crenshaw
reviews.text: Great customer service, very kind and honest staff. They helped us navigate a complicated insurance claim that had me literally super anxious and nervous and biting my nails to the nubs. The staff here made us feel relaxed, and handled every aspect of our situation professionally and with grace. For any body work or collision repair, I highly recommend their services.

reviews.author: John V.
reviews.text: Recently, I had body repair performed on my 2020 Corolla at Barnes. The repair was perfect. Like it never happened. I've used their RV repair in the past as well. Nick is a great guy. They all are an absolute pleasure to deal with. I will be returning to them without hesitation if and when the need ever arises.

reviews.author: Tyler
reviews.text: After a hit and run on my brand new truck, Barnes did a fantastic job repairing all the damage and making it like new again! They were there to help along the way, working with insurance and giving me updates. These are honest people who stand by their work and do a great job. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jennifer Stascak
reviews.text: Barnes Collision did a fantastic job replacing the bumper on my Lexus - it beautiful!!! Super easy to work with and they were sure to communicate every step of the way. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Justin Gutshall
reviews.text: Have to leave another review since my last one. Barnes is the best body shop there is and I would put them against any other body shop . Someone decided to hit and run in a parking lot and Barnes fixed the damage. The repair was impressive. Where I got hit now looks better than it did before the damage. Thank you again for everything and Barnes will always have my business if I unfortunately ever need it. Everyone at Barnes is great. Barnes is awesome. Someone hit my new truck and their insurance - State Farm- would not pay for original GM parts but Barnes made sure I only got GM parts- even covering the cost themselves..Thank you for everything. Everyone is great to speak with. I hope my vehicles are not damaged but if they are Barnes will be the only place I take to.

reviews.author: Matt C
reviews.text: What more can I say about such a great friendly group of people! I stopped in to ask some questions bout my RV needing repair and not only did they provide answers they referred me to another place to handle the glass work that they aren’t able to do! Super friendly knowledge and makes you feel comfortable about trusting them to do your repairs honestly. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Brandon Stokes
reviews.text: I had originally planned on using a different repair shop that my family always uses when our vehicle got hit. But, Ally's cheerful personality, honest assessments, and ability to handle our insurance inspired more than enough confidence in me to go with them. I'm so glad I went with Barnes, and now I know who to call the second something like this happens again... which is hopefully no time soon. :) Thanks, Ally and team!

reviews.author: Ann Pender
reviews.text: We took our RV there and from the initial phone call to the end of the process, we could not have asked for a better experience. Thank you Barnes for your great employees who talked with us first (Misty) and to the very nice gentleman who worked on our RV (great job!) and the overall experience. We were truly blessed by y'all today. We will always remember your generosity and love shown to us. Thank you again.

reviews.author: Lance Wheeler
reviews.text: Works appears to be fine, staff were friendly. Very expensive for RV/Camper repair. I was looking for an alternative to Camping World but this isn’t it.

reviews.author: C. D. Neal
reviews.text: They really are friendly, conscientious people. I called on a whim to see if they could fix the handle on my truck and she immediately said... come on in and let us look at it. They looked up my part and quoted me a price. They called me in a few hours to let me know when they could get the part and set an appointment around my schedule. Then they repaired it faster than they originally thought... aaannnddd... the price didn't change!!! Hallelujah... business integrity...I love it. They are definitely worth checking out!

reviews.author: Noyb Mine
reviews.text: They took care of everything with the insurance company. I like that they had respect for my time and did not have me bring my car in until they had the part. The most impressive thing is that they told me it would be ready in two days, and it was. Very friendly and will explain everything in detail, even if it is Greek to you.

reviews.author: Clifton Harper
reviews.text: Great RV repair service personnel experience with Nick and the Barnes Collision Repair Center Barnes Family that owns and runs this repair facility. Nick has a great hands-on training for most any service needs for any RV. We use them exclusively for our RV service and upgrades when needed/ desired. They work with us to the point that the appointment doesn't seem like a bad experience as we tend to have with the typical RV dealer service centers.

reviews.author: Jim Smith
reviews.text: I was rear ended in my 2017 Volt and called the shop in Raleigh I’d used in the past - they said they couldn’t work on it because they had had such a hard time getting parts. I called Universal Chevy where we got it, and the service manager told me he took his personal vehicles to Barnes and all dealership cars. I’m so glad he did- they were fabulous. Ordered the parts, called when they came in and turned the car around in one day. Looks great, and they washed it AND VACUUMED THE INSIDE! We have a new car!

reviews.author: Mary Yon
reviews.text: They worked us into their busy schedule for a repair on our 2006 Gulfstream Sun Voyager class A motorhome. Their work is very professional. The staff is pleasant and supportive. We highly recommend Barnes Collison.

reviews.author: Private Caller
reviews.text: Had a problem with The tailgate of my pickup. Stopped by they were extremely helpful and coming up with a affordable solution. Would highly recommend them The staff is excellent. I will be using them anytime I need collision work.

reviews.author: Colby Barnes
reviews.text: Barnes Collision is good. I grew up here as a child and they serve really amazing food! service was good, the waiter, ally, was extra sweet, so we tipped her very nicely. David Speight is awesome! head chef Mark Barnes always looks out for the rest of the employees and gives them free pizza and cake. Awesome place to eat!

reviews.author: Jerry Holmes
reviews.text: I went in for a t bone and told them to repaint my driver side door and front body panel and they literally painted it gray when it was supposed to be white. I could have spit in it and used a rattle can and 60 grit sandpaper and done a better job. They also charged me to repaint it the correct color even after I gave them the correct paint code the first time.

reviews.author: Nick Christopoulos
reviews.text: They did an amazing job on the body work of our car after an accident. Looks like it came from the factory and you would never be able to tell that it was in an accident. Alli was very responsive and kept us updated along the way. Highly recommend

reviews.author: James Maas
reviews.text: If you are looking for a great auto or mobile home repair. Look no farther than this. Mark, Nick,Julie and the rest of the crew are a 5 in our book. They repaired our mobile home to like new again and stand behind everything they do and then some. We recommend them HIGHLY and give a 5 star plus.

reviews.author: David Holtz
reviews.text: I've used Barnes Collision multiple times now and they always provide excellent service. I come from Greensboro because their work and service is just THAT GOOD. 5 stars, 2 enthusiastic thumbs up, 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.author: Brian Dupuis
reviews.text: I needed a leaky fresh water tank either repaired or replaced under manufacturer warranty. Getting quality RV repairs locally is not easy. The bigger dealerships have awful service reputations if you can even get an appointment if you didn't buy from them. I called Barnes Collision and Nick in the RV repair shop said they would certainly work with the manufacturer to get the water tank issue addressed. And they did, checking it out, ordering a new one from the manufacturer, and installing it perfectly when it came in. The manufacturer allowed a certain amount of time for the repair, but never mentioned the additional work it would require to extract the old tank and get the new one in which necessitated removing the bay doors and removing sections of bay wall, then fabricating replacement sections. Nick's repair was excellent. I will go back for all of my service issues.

reviews.author: Island Girl
reviews.text: Our car was not kept in a secure area. The paint is full of trash and air bubbles. The clear coat has large drips hanging off of the trunk lid and sharp edges over the doors. We have a large scratch on the front window and chips out of the paint that looks like someone threw rocks at it. High priced and low quality work! Do not recommend!!

reviews.author: Brandon Robinson
reviews.text: Ally and Nick were extremely helpful with getting my RV in quickly and fixing the body work that needed to be done. The price was very fair and I could tell they were genuine about just helping people.

reviews.author: Aaliyah Mattison
reviews.text: Great team! Extremely professional and kind. The work is well done. Have taken multiple vehicles there and they've done a great job! Each time!

reviews.author: Daniel Brown
reviews.text: Alli is amazing at the shop. She takes such good care of us on intake and evaluation. Thanks for helping us through this process

reviews.author: Casey Crist
reviews.text: They did a great job getting my truck repaired in a timely manner and worked with my insurance company and rental car to make everything as easy as possible.

reviews.author: Chris W
reviews.text: Excellent service from beginning estimate, did great job handling insurance payout, and getting what I requested in New parts..

reviews.author: Jeff N
reviews.text: Friendly and prompt response to my request for an estimate. They were very knowledgeable with competitive prices.

reviews.author: Jackie Cota
reviews.text: Had to get estament from a car hitting my car. They are a wonderful and very precise on what to look for when it's not your fault. I recommend them to all who read this

reviews.author: Joy Blackwell Hicks
reviews.text: Made an appointment for an estimate for body repair on my vehicle from a deer hit. On time. Very personable. Perfessional. Estimate was in line with two others I had gotten.

reviews.author: Linda Crofton
reviews.text: Great place to take your RV for service and repair. We've been multiple times I'm sorry to say and they're great to work with each time from initial phone call to pick up.

reviews.author: Allie Thurkill (Sock Thief)
reviews.text: Super friendly people, and they did a great job repairing the damage to my car. There's a reason they're always so busy!

reviews.author: Richard Bello
reviews.text: Only spent a brief time there but during that 1st experience all my mechanical needs we're met in a friendly, comfortable manner. Very friendly and helpful crew

reviews.author: Chris L
reviews.text: Locally owned, run by a family that loves Jesus. If you want to be treated right and have great work done, this is the place for all your auto body needs!!

reviews.author: Dennis Pitt
reviews.text: Good people good service this is one I used again have been there twice.they can bring an automobile back to it orginal appearance.

reviews.author: Mark Williford
reviews.text: If you need your vehicle repaired after a collision, this is the place to go. Factory certifications ensure that these folks do things that satisfy pretty strict standards. And these certs are actually a pretty big deal. Its a major investment for a shop to be able to get and maintain these. I've used them to do a full repaint on a 2005 Lexus and the Pearl White is perfect. I've also used them on much newer vehicles.

reviews.author: Susie J
reviews.text: The entire crew did a fabulous job on my 2026 Chrysler Pacifica!!!! It looks absolutely amazing!!!! I will recommend then to everyone!!!! Thank you so much for the great work!!!!

reviews.author: Wayne Garrett
reviews.text: Just picked up my car from Barnes Collision and it's just like it did the day I drove it off the lot. Would highly recommend them to everybody that ask for a place to have work done
